title: Tathā
text: 2. Cattārimāni bhikkhave ariyasaccāni kātamāni cattāri || || 3. Dukkham ariyasaccam || pe || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || 4. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri ariyasaccāni tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni || tasmā ariyasaccānīti vuccanti || || 5. Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karāṇiyo ti || ||
